updateMessage: Movie Portal v3.5.208 update is ready! Tap UPDATE NOW for universal Android phone playback compatibility (TextureView GPU compositing & 10-bit HEVC auto-transcode).
releaseNotes: Universal Android playback compatibility: TextureView compositing eliminates black-screen punch-through bugs; runtime MediaCodec detection with automatic H.264 transcode for phones lacking 10-bit HEVC hardware decoding.
